baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted فَكُلًّا, the singular possessive in بِذَنۢبِهِ, and the repeated وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Comprehensive inclusion is immediately repartitioned: every group is included, yet each is paired with its own offense and its own mode of seizure. The construction makes judgment distributive rather than an undifferentiated collective blow.

activation_trace.role: The image of encompassing all parts supplies total inclusion while the accusative singular distributes that total one case at a time.
Seizure as being held to account for an emitted offense makes the taking responsive rather than arbitrary.
Offense with a bad outcome supplies the causal link carried by each singular possessive.

changed_reading.before: All the named peoples were punished for sin.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages exact distributive liability: all are within judgment, but no case loses its own deed-to-consequence pairing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The four وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ clauses: أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًا, أَخَذَتْهُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ, خَسَفْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ, and أَغْرَقْنَا.
baseline_models.mechanism: One accountable taking is implemented through distinct physical vectors: released airborne matter, an overwhelming sound, disappearance into the lower ground, and engulfment by water. Repetition holds the cases parallel while the verbs preserve noninterchangeable failure modes.

activation_trace.role: Release and dispatch supply a deliberately sent vector rather than an autonomous weather event.
A severe wind carrying dust or gravel gives the first mode its airborne particulate force.
The terrifying cry supplies an abrupt acoustic mode of seizure.
Ground subsidence and disappearance below it supply the downward mode.
Immersion until destruction supplies the surrounding water mode.

changed_reading.before: The middle of the ayah is a list of four punishments.
changed_reading.after: It is a controlled routing table of judgment: a common liability is realized through materially distinct directions and media.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contrast وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same ظلم predicate is denied of God and reassigned to the groups with their own selves as object. Its branch image of putting something in a wrong place turns the preceding spatial dislocations into an outward materialization of a prior reflexive misplacement.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing outside its proper time or place supplies the spatial logic that the contrast assigns to the agents themselves.
Withholding a right supplies the normative dimension denied of God and charged to the groups.
The self as the thing's own identity makes the harm reflexive rather than transferred to an unrelated victim.
The lower ground gives concrete direction to the wrong-placement mechanism when it receives one group.

changed_reading.before: The closing clause only denies divine injustice and blames the victims.
changed_reading.after: The clause supplies the causal topology of the whole ayah: self-directed misplacement precedes and is exposed through literal displacement, without making God its wrongful source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening test is an assay that separates enacted truth from false profession. The focus seizure by offense can therefore be read as the terminal disclosure of what each collective proved to be under testing, not merely as retaliation after an already transparent classification.

activation_trace.role: Testing metal or a person supplies an assay whose function is to expose rather than merely afflict.
Truth realized in promise and action supplies the positive result measured by the assay.
Contradiction of truth supplies the exposed negative result rather than a mere verbal label.
Accountable seizure attaches the assay's disclosed result back to the focus ayah's taking by offense.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 moves from a spoken claim of belief through testing to the distinction between truthful and false agents; 29:40 closes its historical sequence with each agent taken by its own offense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, enacted truth, falsehood, and accountable seizure; I infer that the historical outcomes function as disclosed assay results. A live alternative is that the opening test and the later destruction scenes remain parallel admonitions without a single assay arc.

changed_reading.before: 29:40 reports punishments imposed on already identified wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: 29:40 also reads as the visible result-sheet of the surah's opening assay: conduct under pressure becomes legible in differentiated outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attempts to get ahead of judgment are denied, while an appointed limit governs arrival; demands to accelerate punishment do not alter that limit, and arrival can still be sudden. The focus ayah's completed past actions become demonstrations that delay is measured restraint rather than successful escape.

activation_trace.role: Getting away from a pursuer supplies the escape model explicitly rejected near the surah's opening.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the measured boundary governing eventual arrival.
Acceleration and premature presentation supply the human demand to control judgment's timing.
Surprise arrival explains how a fixed term can remain experientially abrupt.
Occurrence in time supports the closing contrast's historical actuality and anchors the timing model in the focus.

structural_cues: 29:39 repeats that the immediately named powers were not able to get ahead; 29:40 then narrates completed seizures, while 29:53-55 projects the same nonescape forward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed outstripping, a fixed term, impatient acceleration, surprise, and completed examples; I infer that deferred seizure is calibrated rather than absent. The alternative is a looser warning in which these temporal statements do not form one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The past-tense punishments are remote historical facts.
changed_reading.after: They are temporal proofs: apparent respite never meant outrunning the appointed boundary, whose crossing may be sudden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah gives both polarities of a reflexive law: strenuous effort accrues to one's own self, while wrongdoing also lands on one's own self; every self then crosses death and returns. The focus clause becomes one negative instance of a broader self-to-act-to-return circuit.

activation_trace.role: Exerting full capacity under difficulty supplies the positive action whose benefit returns to its doer.
The self as one's own identity is the explicit beneficiary, establishing reflexive accrual.
Withholding right supplies the negative action that the focus redirects onto the agents' own selves.
Complete inclusion universalizes the focus ayah's distributive each beyond the destroyed collectives.
The living self supplies the individual subject that undergoes death and return.
Loss of life supplies the universal boundary through which every self passes.
Return to the prior source closes the reflexive circuit rather than letting action dissipate.

structural_cues: 29:6 says striving is for the striver's own self; 29:40 says wrongdoing is against the wrongdoers' own selves; 29:57 says every self dies and returns; 29:69 closes with striving that receives guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit reflexive benefit, reflexive harm, universal mortality, and return; I infer one accrual circuit in which action remains attached to its agent. The alternative is that these are separate exhortative and eschatological statements rather than one formal principle.

changed_reading.before: They wronged themselves is an emphatic assignment of blame.
changed_reading.after: It states a surah-wide reflexive law: what an agent exerts or distorts accrues to that self and accompanies it to return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The offer to carry another's errors is denied, but the following ayah says misleading agents carry their own loads plus loads alongside them. Thus بِذَنۢبِهِ marks nontransferable ownership without isolating conduct from social effects: induced harm returns as additional weight on the inducer.

activation_trace.role: Bearing an entrusted or culpable load supplies the proposed transfer that the verse immediately refuses.
Error as sin identifies the liability falsely promised for transfer.
The image of making a load heavy supplies accumulation: one's own burden can gain additional attached burdens.
The singular possessive offense anchors ownership of the resulting seizure in each focus case.

structural_cues: 29:12 juxtaposes we will carry your errors with they will carry nothing of those errors; 29:13 then adds their loads and loads with their loads before 29:40's each by his offense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied substitution, owned loads, added loads, and singular owned offense; I infer nontransferability plus responsibility for propagated effects. A live alternative is to keep the load language as general moral weight without specifying social causation.

changed_reading.before: Each group is punished only for an atomized private sin.
changed_reading.after: Each seizure follows owned liability that cannot be outsourced, yet that liability can accrete through burdens generated in others.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water and earth repeatedly reverse function: surrounding flood coexists with separating rescue by ship; the focus earth can swallow, yet God's earth is spacious and rain makes dead earth live; a vessel again carries people to rescue before they relapse. The media are therefore not intrinsically hostile but discriminating fields of passage, refuge, life, and judgment.

activation_trace.role: An encompassing flood supplies water's destructive surrounding function.
Escape by separation supplies the opposite operation within the same flood setting.
A ship cutting the face of the water supplies the material separator that makes rescue possible.
The lower ground anchors earth's destructive polarity when one group disappears into it.
Fatal immersion anchors water's destructive polarity in the focus.
Expanse opposed to constriction turns earth elsewhere into an open field for faithful movement.
Water in its ordinary material identity supplies the life-bearing medium rather than a punishment symbol.
Earth's life through rain and growth gives the explicit reversal of dead or engulfing terrain.
The vessel moving in water reopens the saving path and tests what agents do after rescue.

structural_cues: 29:14-15 places flood-taking beside ship-rescue; 29:56 calls the earth spacious; 29:63 gives rain and revived earth; 29:65 gives danger at sea, rescue to land, and renewed association.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite material functions for water and earth; I infer that relation and response, not hostile matter itself, determine whether a medium becomes route or closure. The alternative is that the scenes are independent signs with no designed elemental polarity.

changed_reading.before: Wind, ground, and water are destructive instruments in a punishment catalog.
changed_reading.after: The same created media can open, carry, revive, or close; 29:40 records their judicial polarity, not an intrinsically malevolent nature.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence before the focus supplies a flood that takes, a calamity descending from the sky, severe shaking, and bodies fixed to the ground. The initial فَ, fronted كُلًّا, and four مِنْهُم partitions compress that sequence into a case-indexed dossier whose short material labels retain the distinctions among prior scenes.

activation_trace.role: The surrounding flood supplies an earlier fully narrated taking that the focus can compress into drowning.
A descending calamity supplies the prior sky-to-ground vector later condensed among the focus modes.
Severe shaking supplies a distinct earth-borne failure mode in the immediately preceding dossiers.
Adhesion to the ground and immobility supplies the bodily result of that mode.
Encompassing completion lets one compact sentence gather all the preceding cases without erasing their partitions.

structural_cues: 29:14 and 29:31-39 present successive collective cases; 29:40 begins with a consequential fa, gathers each one, and then repartitions the set four times.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, repeated collective dossiers, and matching material vectors; I infer deliberate recap and compression. The alternative is that 29:40 generalizes beyond the immediately narrated cases, so the correspondence need not be a one-to-one index.

changed_reading.before: The four modes are an independent anthology of catastrophes.
changed_reading.after: They are a compact checksum of the preceding case sequence, preserving each dossier's material signature while stating their shared liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus modes occupy complementary directions: airborne matter from above, disappearance below, water around, and sound that reaches without a path. Later context makes the topology explicit as encompassing domination and covering from above and below, while earlier context denies escape in earth or sky.

activation_trace.role: Escape from pursuit supplies the possibility explicitly negated across earth and sky.
The gravel-bearing wind supplies the upper or exposed vector in the focus topology.
Disappearance into the ground supplies the lower vector.
Engulfing water supplies surrounding closure.
Encompassment by overpowering destruction states the enclosing function explicitly.
A covering that generalizes over its objects supplies total envelopment rather than a local strike.
The alternate mapped inventory's covering image independently reinforces the same enveloping surface.
Literal upper direction fixes one boundary of the enclosure.
Literal lower direction fixes the complementary boundary.

structural_cues: 29:22 denies frustration of pursuit in earth or sky and denies protector or helper; 29:39 denies outstripping; 29:54-55 names enclosure and punishment from above and below.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no-escape language, focus modes with distinct directions, and later explicit enclosure; I infer a single topology closing every route. The alternative is that the historical modes and the later eschatological enclosure merely echo one another without forming a designed spatial system.

changed_reading.before: The four punishments differ only in sensory form.
changed_reading.after: Together they map a closure of escape space: above, below, around, and pathless reach are all available to accountable seizure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human taking constructs a dependency system: idols are acquired as social affection, protectors are acquired, and the spider acquires a house. Those bonds reverse into repudiation and the house is declared weakest; divine أخذ in the focus then mirrors and overturns what the agents اتخذوا as protection.

activation_trace.role: Grasping and taking possession supplies the focus-side seizure that reverses the agents' acquisitions.
Acquiring something for oneself supplies the construction of an idol-based support system.
Affection supplies the social adhesive for the acquired system before the verse narrates its reversal.
The doubled acquisition of protectors and a spider house extends the same self-made support mechanism immediately after the focus.
Love, aid, and alliance specify what the acquired protectors are expected to provide.
Shelter and dwelling give the support network an architectural form.
Weakness of force and resolve marks the acquired shelter's inability to perform its protective function.

structural_cues: 29:25 says acquired idols create mutual affection that becomes mutual repudiation and cursing; 29:40 says We took each; 29:41 immediately repeats taking twice for protectors and spider-house.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated أخذ/اتخذ, social attachment, reversal, protector, house, and weakness; I supply the mirror arrow from self-chosen taking to being taken. The live alternative is a lexical echo that intensifies adjacency without making support-collapse the mechanism of seizure.

changed_reading.before: God's taking is simply an external arrest of the guilty.
changed_reading.after: The taking also reverses their own acts of acquisition: self-built networks of affection, alliance, and shelter fail, and the would-be takers are themselves taken.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the contextual sense of ذنب is plainly offense, while tail and water-channel are branch-distant images. It remains anchored in بِذَنۢبِهِ and is activated by the focus's grasping plus earth/water routes; downstream prose should present it only as a root-image model of how consequence follows, never as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: A tail or trailing end supplies an aftermath that stays attached to the act and can catch up with its bearer.
Water channels and valley ends supply a made course along which an attached consequence can arrive.
Grasping turns the trailing or channeled aftermath into the means by which each case is caught.
The surrounding flood activates the channel image materially without changing ذنب's ordinary offense sense.

changed_reading.before: Each was taken because of an offense.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each offense leaves a trailing course of consequence through which its bearer is eventually grasped.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because كُلًّا means each/all here, whereas the thin protective house is a remote branch of the same root. The immediately following spider-house and its weakness visibly activate that branch, so it is worth retaining as an echo; downstream prose must label it a root-network resonance, not a lexical gloss of فَكُلًّا.

activation_trace.role: A thin sewn covering shaped like a protective house supplies a distant shelter image latent at the focus root.
The explicit shelter immediately after the focus activates the distant cover-house branch.
Structural weakness explains why the self-made protective cover cannot withstand the focus's diverse vectors.
Windborne gravel supplies one concrete force that a thin shelter cannot exclude.

changed_reading.before: Each group is included in the judgment.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified root echo, each supposedly protective covering or house is shown penetrable, preparing the spider-house comparison.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the physical صيحة as a rhetorical counter-utterance rather than only a sound-event. It remains anchored in the focus cry and in the surah's sequence from human claims to punishment that itself says taste; downstream prose should call it a discourse-level echo, not claim that صيحة lexically means rebuttal.

activation_trace.role: Spoken production supplies the opening human profession whose adequacy the test questions.
Raised overwhelming sound supplies the nonpropositional counter-voice that one group cannot control.
Punishment's own imperative speech makes the shift from human claim to answering voice explicit.
Experiencing and being tested turns the final command to taste into embodied verification rather than further debate.

changed_reading.before: The cry is one physical punishment among four.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cry is also the surah's counter-voice: unsupported professions and demands give way to an answer experienced by the body.

strongest_changes: The focus becomes the disclosed result of the surah's opening assay rather than a detached punishment report.
Singular owned offense is nontransferable but can accumulate socially generated burdens.
Water and earth alternate between rescue, spaciousness, life, and destruction, making the focus media discriminating rather than intrinsically hostile.
The repeated taking mirrors and overturns human acquisition of idols, allies, affection, and shelter.
The four modes jointly close escape space from above, below, around, and through pathless reach.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context changed the ayah from a static catastrophe list into a hinge joining trial, owned consequence, calibrated time, fragile dependency structures, elemental reversals, and universal return while preserving several materially distinct readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus clearly compresses the preceding collective sequence, but a strict one-to-one assignment of every mode to every named case would require more than the packet itself states.
The mirror between divine taking and human acquisition is textually strong, while the claim that support-collapse is the causal arrow remains reader-supplied.
The tail/channel, thin-house, and counter-voice readings are deliberately branch-distant and should remain qualified exploratory echoes.
